title: Goodness-of-fit testing for nonlinear inverse problems with random observations
summary: This work is concerned with nonparametric goodness-of-fit testing in the context of nonlinear inverse problems with random observations. Bayesian posterior distributions based upon a Gaussian process prior distribution are proven to contract at a certain rate uniformly over a set of true parameters. The corresponding posterior mean is shown to converge uniformly at the posterior contraction rate in the sense of satisfying a concentration inequality.
